what_this_wave_will_NOT_claim: A canonical re-read is an ASSESSMENT of a sealed dossier and never becomes a sealed number.  Every child below is sealed on the frozen fifteen under the frozen protocol first, and read a second time under the canonical standard second, and the two counts are carried side by side everywhere.

The repetition-penalty decode in lane C3 is a RUNTIME DIAGNOSTIC.  It changes a decode parameter and not a byte of any child, it is never sealed, it never appears in a ledger row, and no fold claim rests on it.
The v2 extension bank in lane C4 is a candidate instrument under calibration.  If its rank correlation does not beat the retired v1 surface's pooled 0.69 it is reported as no-better and not adopted.
